subject: Ariba invite failing after SSO — relaystate / claim missing
messages:
From: Elena Costa <elena.costa@hearthwell.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hearthwell Procurement <procurement@hearthwell.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Issue: Ariba invite link drops to error after SSO

Hi Jonas / Laura,

We received an Ariba invite from Redwood this morning but when our users try to accept it they get routed to our SSO, complete the login, and then the browser lands on Ariba's error page with a message like "Claim missing / relay state invalid". I've attached a screenshot.

We tested on Chrome and Edge; same result. Clearing cookies didn't help. One of our users tried via mobile and got the same redirect loop to /error?claim=.

Can you reissue the invite or provide a workaround? This is blocking a PO that needs to be created today.

Details:
- Company: Hearthwell Pharma
- Primary user: elena.costa@hearthwell.com (has corporate SSO)
- Attempted browsers: Chrome 117 (Windows), Edge 117 (Windows), iOS Safari
- Error shown: "Missing RelayState / Claim not found" (screenshot attached)

Thanks,
Elena Costa
Procurement Manager
Hearthwell Pharma

Attachment: screenshot-relaystate-error.png (PNG, 148KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Costa <elena.costa@hearthwell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Issue: Ariba invite link drops to error after SSO

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear repro notes and the screenshot.

Short answer: we suspect the RelayState (the Ariba claim token appended to the invite link) is being truncated or rewritten during the SSO handoff, which causes Ariba to reject the assertion after IdP login. Two common culprits: (1) the corporate proxy / email client rewriting the link when the invite is clicked, or (2) an IdP policy that truncates query params on POST/redirect.

What I'll do next:
- Reissue a fresh invite with a shorter claim token (one-time, 24h TTL) and send it directly to the user email.
- Ask engineering to pull the Ariba SSO handoff trace for the invite you clicked — I attached a trace-request file we need you to trigger (ariba_sso_trace.txt). If possible, please attempt one more acceptance and then send us the timestamp (UTC) of the click.

Workarounds while we investigate:
- Try accepting the invite from an incognito window (bypasses some email client rewriting).
- If your IdP admin can allow the redirect path /ariba/relay for the short window, that avoids truncation.

I'll follow up once engineering confirms. I've cc'd Ben and Laura to keep procurement and SSO ops in the loop.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber | Partner Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: ariba_sso_trace.txt (instructions to collect SAML traces)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Issue: Ariba invite link drops to error after SSO

On it — I'll open an infra ticket and assign to the SSO team.

Checklist for INF/SAML team (quick):
1) Pull Ariba assertion logs for Hearthwell for the timestamps Jonas requests.
2) Confirm if RelayState appears at the IdP redirect and if it survives the POST to Ariba.
3) If RelayState is missing, check if any intermediate reverse-proxy (WAF) is rewriting or dropping long query strings.
4) Temp option: generate a time-bound direct activation token (short link) and mark it as OA-allowed for Hearthwell domain. Security will need to approve — I'll ping Security now.

I'm raising: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8421 with priority P1 and adding SSO oncall.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Reliability Eng (Edge / SSO)
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Costa <elena.costa@hearthwell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T15:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Issue: Ariba invite link drops to error after SSO — relaystate / claim missing

Hi Elena — quick update and a reissued link.

What we did:
- Engineering confirmed the redirect from our side looks correct; the RelayState was present when we issued the invite but the IdP POST to Ariba did not include it in the failed attempts you reported (INF-8421). That points to an IdP/proxy rewrite on your side. Ben's team is continuing to investigate.

What I sent you now:
- Reissued invite (one-time token, 24h TTL): https://supplier.ariba.com/invite?claim=REISSUED-INVITE-TOKEN-********
  * Please open in an incognito window or a different device. Copy-paste the full link into the browser address bar rather than clicking from the email client if possible.
- If the link still fails, please run the small trace in the attached ariba_sso_trace.txt immediately after you reproduce the error and share the timestamp (UTC). That trace logs the IdP -> Ariba POST parameters — that will tell us whether RelayState was delivered.

Meeting: I've proposed a 30-minute troubleshooting slot on Friday (invite attached) to open a live session with your IdP admin and our SSO oncall. If you can share the IdP contact beforehand (email and best callback number) we can loop them into the meeting.

If you want a temporary manual workaround, our procurement team can create a vendor placeholder and attach PO info while we sort SSO; that avoids the immediate PO delay but isn't ideal for later reconciliations.

Thanks for the patience — we'll get this resolved quickly.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
